"Deris Plata.|A shore trooper and Cassian Andor||audio=}} '''Deris-plata''' was a [[planet]]{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} located in the [[Eucer sector]] within the [[Mid Rim Territories]]. Incognito [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] claimed to be from Deris-plata during his time on [[Niamos]].
